component.name: nmap-gui
component.summary: Scan your network with nmap in a modern interface

description.p: nmap-gui is a modern, easy interface for the nmap network scanner. It runs on your own computer and opens in your web browser.

ul.li: Ten ready-made scan types, from finding devices to full service and OS detection
Live progress with devices and open ports appearing as they are found
Results as device cards, a filterable port table and a network map
Scan history, and a comparison that shows what changed since an earlier scan
A ready-to-send email note about the changes, from your own template

description.p: Only scan networks and computers you own or have permission to scan.

screenshot.caption: Choose a target and one of ten ready-made scan types
Results: one card per device, dark theme
Network map coloured by open ports
What changed since the last scan, with an email note

description.p: First release: scan presets, live results, network map, history, change reports with email note, desktop launcher.
